chapter: Early life and the New Orleans band scene
title: Playing the district as a boy in short pants, starting on trumpet
summary: He went into the district at 14 or 15, wearing long pants over his short ones, and says he started on trumpet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Well, how old were you when you could first go in the district?

In the district, I was in short pants. To go to work at night time, I'd have to put long pants on top of my short pants. Because you wasn't allowed. Nobody, no. Yep. Well, this wasn't allowed in the district with short pants. I'd wear them, you remember the old days? We'd wear stockings. I'd put a pair of long pants over my short pants to go to work at night.
So you must have been quite young. Nothing but a kid. At least I was a fighter.
Fourteen years old, fifteen years old. And you started on the carnet?
On trumpet. Started on trumpet. Did your folks play anything? Your father?
